pairs.why: Both match the real card's orange roof, yellow body and brown trunk, so color gives no reason to choose.
Both have a purple wall that is louder than the real muted lavender, plus bright books and the same blue shoes.
B keeps the real card's dark-blue body with dark-blue keys and a few cyan accents, while A adds cream keys that the real card doesn't have.
A keeps to the real card's white sails, orange hull, purple-pink sky and teal water, while B adds yellow flags as an extra accent hue.
A's wood is a calmer orange-brown like the real floor, while B pushes the wall and floor to a hot red-orange and the gold is louder.
A has a paler yellow center in its background, closer to the real card, while B's background is a deeper red-orange.
Both have the same saturated green grass, mauve stone and open blue sky, with no clear difference from the real card.
B's dark-blue keys with cyan operator keys match the real card's blue and cyan scheme, while A's cream keys add an off-palette hue.
